sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 489 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 67 of 67 campsites parsed)

values.note: Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' DEC's 2026 campground summary. ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/woodland-valley/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=489 (Booking Window 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights will be permitted at any campground'; CHECK-IN TIME 'by 9:00 p.m. on the first night') + DEC 2026 campground summary (Woodland Valley RES MIN 2), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 69 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 67, all back-in: 11 listed at 30 ft, 37 at 20 ft, 19 with no length given. Mostly wooded, some along a small stream.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf ('Woodland Valley 845-688-7647 69') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 489 (Equip length/Driveway '20 Back-In' 37, '30 Back-In' 11, 'Back-In' 19) + campground page ('The park's campsites are mostly wooded, with some campsites located along a small stream'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 489 (all 67 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/woodland-valley/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=489 ('flush toilets, hot showers, a trailer dump station'), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC (Catskill Forest Preserve), near Phoenicia, at the foot of Slide Mountain; trailhead for the Slide-Wittenberg and Woodland Valley-Denning trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident, phone 845-688-7647, 2-night pre-season reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10 (matches), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max (now on the entry), no electric (now from the RA site list), 69 sites to 30 ft (now verified; all back-in). Added showers, flush toilets, dump. Note trimmed of sites/length/hookups/booking/minimum-stay text. Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
flags: Minor: only 11 of the 67 bookable sites are listed at 30 ft (37 at 20 ft, 19 with no length), so a 23-ft rig must pick from those 11 (or the unlisted ones).
